interactionPlan.concept: Illustrating the effect of intrinsic and extrinsic camera parameters in perspective projection.

interactions.label: Focal Length (a)
interactions.teaches: Demonstrates how changing the focal length (a) affects the perspective distortion on the image plane.

interactions.label: Principal Point Shift (n0, m0)
interactions.teaches: Shows the impact of changing the principal point on image centering and distortion.

interactions.label: Rotation Angle (θ)
interactions.teaches: Illustrates how rotating the camera around the X-axis changes the view on the image plane.

interactions.label: Show Axes
interactions.teaches: Helps in understanding the orientation of the 3D space related to the camera.

interactionPlan.camera_suggestion: Initial viewpoint should be slightly offset from behind the camera to give a clear view of the image plane and the effect of parameter changes.
interactionPlan.notes: Ensure axes and image plane remain visible during interactions for better spatial understanding.

gpt-4o.notes: The 3D figure accurately represents the original with correct geometry and interactive controls, though some labels have minor placement issues.
